app.name: Snes9x GX ULTIMATE
app.coder: VrepliroidV (Snes9x TX: Tanooki, Snes9x GX: Tantric)
app.long_description:
Snes9x GX ULTIMATE by VrepliroidV, based on Snes9x TX (Tanooki), a fork of Snes9x GX (Tantric).
This build also reads Xbox 360 (XInput) USB controllers and 2.4 GHz receivers plugged into the Wii, as GameCube controllers. L + Select + Start opens the menu. PNG bezels around the game in 480i/480p, Auto Crop of black borders, automatic CPU overclock, per-game settings, Game Genie and Action Replay codes typed in the cheats menu, region option NTSC (Lie to PAL).
